metrics.title: Current-period revenue
metrics.description: Revenue for the current reporting period used as a statement input and comparison context.

metrics.title: Previous-period revenue
metrics.description: Comparable prior-period revenue used to calculate growth.

metrics.title: Net profit or loss
metrics.description: Current-period net result used to calculate profitability.

metrics.title: Total assets
metrics.description: Period-end asset base used in profitability and leverage calculations.

metrics.title: Current assets
metrics.description: Period-end current assets used to calculate liquidity.

metrics.title: Current liabilities
metrics.description: Period-end current liabilities used to calculate liquidity.

metrics.title: Total interest-bearing debt
metrics.description: Interest-bearing borrowings used to calculate leverage.

metrics.title: Operating cash flow
metrics.description: Operating cash generation retained as a distinct supporting indicator.

metrics.title: Return on assets
metrics.description: Net profit divided by total assets; a reported ratio remains acceptable when its calculation basis is traceable.

metrics.title: Revenue growth
metrics.description: Period-over-period revenue change calculated from comparable revenue values.

metrics.title: Current ratio
metrics.description: Current assets divided by current liabilities.

metrics.title: Debt to assets
metrics.description: Interest-bearing debt divided by total assets; no universal adverse threshold is assumed.

metrics.title: Requested amount
metrics.description: Capital requested by the SME, interpreted with project cost and use of funds.

metrics.title: Project cost
metrics.description: Total cost of the proposed project with an explicit cost scope.

metrics.title: Expected annual financial savings
metrics.description: Projected annual savings retained as a forecast rather than achieved performance.

metrics.title: Requested financing share
metrics.description: Requested amount divided by total project cost.

metrics.title: Simple payback period
metrics.description: Project cost divided by expected annual savings, with assumptions retained.
